title: X-LAB RS5
notes: International official page: US$1,399 with free shipping in the contiguous U.S. and one listed finish. XDS X6 aluminium-alloy frame (UDH compatible) with endurance geometry, XDS carbon fork with 100×12 mm thru-axle, Branta alloy integrated cockpit, aero carbon seatpost, Shimano 105 mechanical RD/FD-R7100 with ST-R7120 and BR-R7170, CS-R7101 11–34T, Branta alloy power-meter crankset 52/36T with 24 mm steel spindle, BSA 24 mm bottom bracket, Branta PN28 160/160 mm rotors, Branta A35 SL alloy wheels, Branta R332 700×32C tires, maximum tire clearance 38C and 9.54 kg for size L. Five sizes XS–XL; stack/reach XS 530/371, S 553/375, M 575/381, L 599/387, XL 623/394 mm.
